summary: Tested Web Push Notification opt-in feature for Employee Dashboard. All 11 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified notification settings card appears correctly with proper data-testid attributes and conditional rendering based on Notification.permission state.
critical_code_review_comments: Notification card correctly uses pushChecked state to only render after async push status check completes
Card properly shows 'Blocked in browser settings' + Unblock button when Notification.permission is 'denied'
Card shows toggle switch when permission is 'default' (not testable in headless browser)
Card correctly hidden when isAdminView=true (verified on admin dashboard)
VAPID public key endpoint correctly returns valid key without requiring authentication
Subscribe/unsubscribe endpoints properly require authentication and handle subscription lifecycle
seed_data_creation: Test subscriptions created and cleaned up during backend tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web Push Notification opt-in feature tested. Backend endpoints: GET /api/web-push/vapid-public-key (no auth), POST /api/web-push/subscribe (auth required), DELETE /api/web-push/subscribe?endpoint=... (auth required), GET /api/web-push/status (auth required). Frontend: notification-settings-card appears on employee dashboard after pushChecked=true, shows 'Blocked in browser settings' + Unblock button when Notification.permission='denied', shows toggle switch when permission='default'. Card hidden in admin view (isAdminView=true). Headless browsers have Notification.permission='denied' so toggle won't be visible in automated tests.
